name: alakazam_ml_v32
model: The unchanged v31 safety and exact-memory shell followed by a 657-feature large-leaf LambdaRank model trained on all 999 usable Yushin Ito trajectories. Chronological training weights use floor 0.25 and power 2.0. The numeric-ID model was rejected and omitted.
model_scope: The learned policy covers unseen single-choice MAIN decisions. Exact Majkel memory handles previously recorded questions; v29 and the deterministic policy remain fallbacks for unsupported, unsafe, low-time, or illegal cases.

teacher_training.episode_split: Chronological 70/10/20 by episode ID within Yushin submission 54773249.

research_only.runtime_dependency: PyTorch CPU; not included in the submission agent
research_only.interpretation: The eight-model family contains a correct answer for 91.68% of held-out decisions, but the best learned/fixed selector chooses correctly only 80.12% of the time. Oracle accuracy is not deployable Top-1 accuracy.

same_test_external_reference.caveat: Rmy was excluded from both final fits, but it had been inspected during earlier experiments; this is a secondary same-test comparison, not a pristine model-selection holdout.

safety_guards: Always preserve a deterministic immediate lethal attack.
Reject candidates that destroy a currently available KO.
Never end the turn while the Active Alakazam can attack.
Do not cycle Dudunsparce away from a board of two or fewer Pokemon.
Use the frozen v29 policy for unsupported, nested, low-time, or illegal cases.
known_limitations: The requested 90% unseen Top-1 agreement was not reached. The best deployable strict held-out Top-1 is 78.71%.
The 78.71% v32 score is measured on Yushin's chronological holdout, while v31's 76.31% was measured on Majkel's chronological holdout; the 2.40-point difference is not a same-test causal comparison.
On the same excluded Rmy test, v32 is 61.67% versus v31 58.43% (+3.24 points), but Rmy had been inspected in earlier research and remains only a secondary reference.
The research six-model blend reaches 80.12%, not 90%. An eight-model oracle reaches 91.68% but is not an implementable selector.
v31 remains the real-ladder champion until v32 is submitted and measured.
